svg.title: Track Rush: all 12 tracks
svg.text: Top view of every track (each panel has its own scale bar). Road colour shows height; generated by tools/generateTracks.mjs.

g.text: 1 Rookie Oval
3 laps · 2.17 km per lap · meadow · width 20-22 m
height 2-5 m · 4 checkpoints · 0 jumps · tightest radius 67 m
A wide, flowing loop with gentle slopes: learn the car and carry
speed through the sweepers.
2 Hairpin Valley
3 laps · 2.42 km per lap · alpine · width 13 m
height 1-17 m · 5 checkpoints · 0 jumps · tightest radius 16 m
Climb three switchbacks, cross the ridge and drop down two more:
brake early, power out.
3 Ramp Rally
3 laps · 2.37 km per lap · desert · width 15 m
height 1-9 m · 5 checkpoints · 4 jumps · tightest radius 35 m
Four kicker jumps from 4 to 7 m: hit each ramp straight and land
on the long run-outs.
4 Banked Speedway
3 laps · 2.84 km per lap · dusk · width 18 m
height 6-9 m · 6 checkpoints · 0 jumps · tightest radius 142 m
Steep banked bowls hold the car at full speed: trust the banking
and stay flat out.
5 Technical Trial
3 laps · 2.59 km per lap · canyon · width 10-16 m
height 1-13 m · 6 checkpoints · 1 jump · tightest radius 15 m
Narrow chicanes, a jump, banked sweepers and a switchback climb:
rhythm beats top speed.
6 Grand Marathon
sprint · 7.18 km · meadow · width 11-16 m
height 2-15 m · 19 checkpoints · 2 jumps · tightest radius 16 m
Over 6 km point to point: jumps, switchbacks, banked bowls and
narrow chicanes in one run.
7 Coastal GP
3 laps · 2.90 km per lap · dusk · width 12-18 m
height 2-8 m · 6 checkpoints · 0 jumps · tightest radius 30 m
A fast grand-prix circuit at sunset: big braking zones, quick
esses and a narrow final sector.
8 Mountain Pass
sprint · 4.50 km · alpine · width 13-14 m
height 1-18 m · 10 checkpoints · 0 jumps · tightest radius 18 m
A 4.5 km sprint over the pass: banked switchbacks up to the
summit and a fast, twisting descent.
9 Canyon Run
3 laps · 2.85 km per lap · canyon · width 10-13 m
height 4-16 m · 7 checkpoints · 2 jumps · tightest radius 13 m
Out and back through narrow red-rock badlands with jumps, blind
crests and tight S-bends: the hardest circuit.
10 Night Highway
3 laps · 3.12 km per lap · night · width 18 m
height 3-6 m · 7 checkpoints · 0 jumps · tightest radius 28 m
Kilometre-long straights under the lights: brake hard for the
slow corners and fire the nitro out of them.
11 Lighthouse Bay
3 laps · 2.35 km per lap · seaside · width 17-18 m
height 2-6 m · 5 checkpoints · 0 jumps · tightest radius 62 m
Long sweeping bends round the bay, past the lighthouse: throw
the car sideways and hold the drift.
12 Seaside Stunts
sprint · 3.02 km · seaside · width 16 m
height 1-17 m · 6 checkpoints · 6 jumps · tightest radius 49 m
Six kickers down the coast road, with step-downs and a 7.5 m
launch: line up straight and fly far.

svg.text: start, pointing the way to drive
sprint finish (circuits finish at the start)
